description:
What importers from a country actually paid on a code in the latest 3 months Census has
    published: base rate plus Chapter 99 duties (Section 301, 232 and the like), as a percent of
    value, by month. Not the duty a shipment will owe today (Census is about 2 months behind and
    the rules change), and anti-dumping/countervailing duties are not included. For "what will
    this cost", not for classifying.

code.description: An HTS code, 6 to 10 digits, dotted or not (8205.51.30).
code.title: Code

country_of_origin.description: Country of origin: name, ISO code or common alias (China, CN, PRC, Viet Nam).
country_of_origin.title: Country Of Origin
